text_block_list.text: Our summer training camp with Vivlos—all about "working hard without overworking"—was proceeding entirely without a hitch—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...!
*wheeze*...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... It hurts a bit, but
I think I'll be fine once I rest and take a deep breath!
choice_data_list: Let's resume once things settle down, then.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Understood!
I'll let you know once I feel like I'm okay.
choice_data_list: Go get some rest under the parasol.
Take a rest under the parasol, okay?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Thanks for getting everything ready!

Vivlos listens carefully to what I say
and immediately lets me know if anything feels even slightly off.
Thanks to that, there are no concerns for now.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: You're working hard, aren't you, Vilosh?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Good work.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Big Sis, Cheval-chi!
Ah, is that juice?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
It's orange juice.
choice_data_list: Since you're here, why not rest inside?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'll do that--!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Phaaah!
So good!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, both of you!
Especially you, Cheval...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You're in the middle of working hard on training, right?
Thanks for taking the time!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Big sis is...
...No, never mind."

After kicking off the year with a brilliant victory in the GII Hanshin Daishoten,
she unexpectedly fell off the board in her most recent race.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Still,
that took me by surprise earlier."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
That conversation with your Trainer.
I didn't know you could speak so properly.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Responsible?
I'm always responsible, you know~?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yeah. But the atmosphere was so serious. It felt kind of refreshing.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
She's the youngest, right?
That must be why she watched us so closely.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: She picked up everything so quickly, knew how to act pampered, was so dexterous... and was always smiling.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Getting into Tracen Academy
wasn't a struggle at all, either.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
So... I was worried that if you ever
hit a massive obstacle,
you might end up breaking under the pressure.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
“Still, you seem completely fine.
I had no idea you had such a strong side to you.”

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe.
After all, I'm their little sister.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Big sis... and Cheval, too.
My grit is just like the two of you, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, that might be true for you, Sis.
But I...—"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You're already plenty amazing, Cheva-chi.
Suuuper! Amazing!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ever since running in the Twinkle Series,
I've come to understand it very well.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"I want to be just like the two of them!"
Thinking that gives me courage.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Vivlos...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...You've really grown.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~.
Yep!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I'll show you
how much I've grown!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Trainy,
can those two train me?

Given the workload, receiving instruction from both of them seems tough.
If I have to choose one, considering their respective specialties...
choice_data_list: Get power training from Cheval Grand

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Huh.
Me!?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
No, someone like me...
There's nothing I could possibly teach Vivlos.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Why?
There are tons of them, you know?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I mean, Cheval-chi's running
just feels so powerful.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
She looks so cool when she runs, too~♡
And the way she surges ahead at the end is so fierce!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: T-That's not... true at all!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
Why are you running away~!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry for the racket.
Those kids are always like that.
choice_data_list: It's nice that you get along so well, isn't it?
It's nice that you get along so well.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Wait up, Cheval-chi~♪

After chasing Cheval Grand for a while,
Vivlos surely must have built up some real power.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ohh, as expected of Trainy!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Your running style is pure grit!
It's so cool, Big Sis ♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Does that mean
I'm terribly unrefined?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Whoa!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainy!
We have to get back now, don't we?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Don't just stand there looking blank~!
Come on, let's go—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
please, leave this child to me.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—I will thoroughly teach you
what it truly means to get down and dirty.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
—Awww, no waaaay~
Big sis~~, I don't wanna do this anymore~~!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: No. 100 more squats.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: You demon~~!!
Verxina is normally gentle when she's with Vivlos... but today, she showed the fierce intensity befitting a "Queen."
